metadata.description: AI-native policy engine governing SQL qualification decisions by evaluating evidence, scoring qualification dimensions, calculating confidence, applying qualification gates, generating recommendations, and guiding Gemini reasoning.

qualification_policy.purpose: Defines the global qualification philosophy and minimum requirements for converting assessed opportunities into SQL decisions.

ai_policy.purpose: Govern Gemini on applying qualification philosophy before calculating qualification outcomes.
ai_policy.execution_priority: Qualification logic must prioritize evidence quality, business context, and buyer validation over simple numerical scoring.
ai_policy.gemini_behavior: Gemini must evaluate whether the opportunity demonstrates genuine buying readiness rather than only relying on completed fields.
ai_policy.explanation_requirement: Every qualification decision must include rationale, supporting evidence references, and identified gaps.

qualification_method.description: SQL qualification is determined through evaluation of ten qualification dimensions supported by validated business evidence.

qualified_sql.definition: Opportunity demonstrates sufficient business need, buying readiness, stakeholder engagement, and commercial viability.

borderline_sql.definition: Opportunity shows potential but requires additional evidence or risk mitigation before full qualification.

needs_nurturing.definition: Opportunity lacks sufficient evidence maturity and requires further engagement.

disqualified.definition: Opportunity does not meet qualification requirements or contains critical blocking conditions.

evidence_evaluation_policy.purpose: Defines how individual evidence objects are evaluated before dimension scoring.

ai_policy.purpose: Guide Gemini in assessing evidence quality and reliability.
ai_policy.execution_priority: Evidence quality must be evaluated before evidence quantity.
ai_policy.gemini_behavior: Gemini must distinguish between customer-confirmed evidence, seller assumptions, and unsupported claims.
ai_policy.explanation_requirement: Gemini must explain why evidence is considered strong, weak, incomplete, or unreliable.

evidence_objects.evaluation_focus: Whether relevant evidence exists and is clearly identified.
Whether evidence has been validated by customer stakeholders or reliable sources.
Whether evidence demonstrates sufficient detail and understanding.
Whether evidence connects to business impact, strategic objectives, or measurable outcomes.
Whether risks, uncertainties, and potential blockers are identified.

strong.description: Evidence is validated, specific, customer-confirmed, and strategically relevant.

moderate.description: Evidence exists but requires further validation or deeper understanding.

weak.description: Evidence is incomplete, assumed, or insufficiently validated.

missing.description: Required evidence is unavailable or unsupported.

dimension_scoring_policy.purpose: Defines how the five evidence objects within each SQL qualification dimension are evaluated and converted into dimension-level scores.

ai_policy.purpose: Guide Gemini in transforming evidence assessments into dimension-level qualification scores.
ai_policy.execution_priority: Gemini must evaluate evidence quality before calculating dimension scores.
ai_policy.gemini_behavior: Gemini must consider evidence completeness, validation strength, business relevance, and risk exposure when determining dimension maturity.
ai_policy.explanation_requirement: Every dimension score must include evidence references, scoring rationale, strengths, weaknesses, and improvement recommendations.

advanced.description: Dimension has strong validated evidence and demonstrates buyer readiness.

developing.description: Dimension demonstrates progress but requires additional validation.

weak.description: Dimension lacks sufficient evidence depth or business confirmation.

dimension_calculation_rules.formula: Dimension Score = Σ(Evidence Score × Evidence Weight)

overall_scoring_policy.purpose: Defines how the ten SQL qualification dimension scores are aggregated into an overall SQL opportunity score.

ai_policy.purpose: Guide Gemini in calculating overall qualification strength.
ai_policy.execution_priority: Overall scoring must consider dimension importance and strategic relevance.
ai_policy.gemini_behavior: Gemini must not interpret a high overall score as qualified when critical dimensions are weak.
ai_policy.explanation_requirement: Overall score explanations must identify strongest dimensions, weakest dimensions, and qualification risks.

scoring_method.formula: Overall SQL Score = Σ(Dimension Score × Dimension Weight)

excellent.description: Opportunity demonstrates strong SQL readiness across critical dimensions.

strong.description: Opportunity is qualified but may require targeted risk mitigation.

moderate.description: Opportunity has potential but requires additional evidence.

positive_adjustments.condition: All mandatory dimensions exceed minimum threshold

negative_adjustments.condition: Two or more mandatory dimensions below threshold

qualification_decision_policy.purpose: Defines how SQL qualification outcomes are determined based on overall score, confidence level, mandatory dimensions, and critical qualification conditions.

ai_policy.purpose: Guide Gemini in making final qualification decisions using transparent and explainable logic.
ai_policy.execution_priority: Decision logic must evaluate critical gates and confidence before relying on numerical scores.
ai_policy.gemini_behavior: Gemini must avoid qualifying opportunities solely based on high scores when evidence quality, buyer validation, or governance readiness is insufficient.
ai_policy.explanation_requirement: Every qualification decision must include decision rationale, supporting evidence, qualification risks, and recommended next actions.

SQL_Qualified.definition: Opportunity has sufficient evidence maturity, business alignment, stakeholder engagement, and buying readiness to enter active sales pipeline management.

Borderline_SQL.definition: Opportunity shows meaningful potential but requires additional evidence or risk mitigation before full SQL confirmation.
typical_conditions: Strong business problem but incomplete governance
Strong solution fit but unclear decision criteria
High interest but insufficient commercial confirmation

Needs_Nurturing.definition: Opportunity requires further engagement, education, or discovery before qualification readiness.
typical_conditions: Problem awareness exists but urgency is unclear

Disqualified.definition: Opportunity does not demonstrate sufficient qualification evidence or violates critical qualification requirements.

confidence_policy.purpose: Defines how confidence in SQL qualification decisions is calculated independently from opportunity score.

ai_policy.purpose: Ensure Gemini evaluates confidence based on evidence reliability rather than opportunity attractiveness.
ai_policy.execution_priority: Confidence calculation must prioritize evidence quality, validation, and completeness.
ai_policy.gemini_behavior: Gemini must reduce confidence when evidence is incomplete, assumed, contradictory, or insufficiently validated.
ai_policy.explanation_requirement: Confidence explanations must identify confidence drivers, uncertainty sources, and required evidence improvements.

Evidence Completeness.description: Measures whether required evidence across dimensions has been collected.

Evidence Validation.description: Measures whether evidence is confirmed by appropriate customer stakeholders.

Evidence Consistency.description: Measures whether evidence is internally consistent without contradictions.

Business Context Quality.description: Measures whether evidence connects to strategic business outcomes.

Risk Transparency.description: Measures whether risks and uncertainties are properly identified.

High Confidence.description: Qualification decision is strongly supported by validated evidence.

Medium Confidence.description: Qualification decision is reasonable but additional evidence may improve certainty.

Insufficient Confidence.description: Evidence quality is insufficient to support reliable qualification.

critical_gate_policy.purpose: Defines mandatory qualification conditions that can override numerical scores and prevent inaccurate SQL qualification decisions.

ai_policy.purpose: Guide Gemini in applying non-negotiable qualification controls before final SQL decisions.
ai_policy.execution_priority: Critical gates must be evaluated before score-based qualification logic.
ai_policy.gemini_behavior: Gemini must not qualify an opportunity when critical business, stakeholder, buying, or commercial evidence requirements are absent.
ai_policy.explanation_requirement: Every gate evaluation must state the triggered condition, impact on qualification, and required remediation action.

condition.trigger: Business Problem dimension score below minimum threshold OR no validated business challenge identified

CG001.required_action: Conduct business discovery to validate customer problem, urgency, and impact.

condition.trigger: Evidence exists primarily from seller assumptions without customer confirmation

CG002.required_action: Obtain customer-confirmed evidence from relevant stakeholders.

condition.trigger: No identified business owner, sponsor, or decision participant

CG003.required_action: Map stakeholders and identify decision influence structure.

condition.trigger: No understanding of customer evaluation, approval, or procurement process

CG004.required_action: Complete buying process and governance discovery.

CG005.required_action: Validate budget, procurement pathway, commercial model, and purchasing feasibility.

risk_penalty_policy.purpose: Defines how identified opportunity risks reduce SQL scores, confidence, and qualification readiness.

ai_policy.purpose: Guide Gemini in incorporating risk exposure into qualification decisions.
ai_policy.execution_priority: Risks must be evaluated separately from opportunity attractiveness.
ai_policy.gemini_behavior: Gemini must identify qualification risks even when positive evidence exists.
ai_policy.explanation_requirement: Every risk adjustment must include risk source, severity, impact, and mitigation recommendation.

risk_categories.description: Risk that customer problem, urgency, or strategic importance is insufficient.
Risk caused by missing sponsors, decision makers, or stakeholder alignment.
Risk caused by unclear solution fit or technical uncertainty.
Risk caused by budget, procurement, pricing, or commercial uncertainty.
Risk caused by competitors, alternatives, or lack of differentiation.
Risk caused by timeline, resources, governance, or implementation concerns.

critical_risk_conditions.condition: Multiple High or Critical risks exist across mandatory dimensions

recommendation_policy.purpose: Defines how RevOS generates evidence improvement actions, qualification recommendations, and next-best actions based on SQL assessment results.

ai_policy.purpose: Guide Gemini in generating actionable recommendations after qualification evaluation.
ai_policy.execution_priority: Recommendations must address qualification gaps before suggesting acceleration activities.
ai_policy.gemini_behavior: Gemini must prioritize actions that improve evidence quality, reduce qualification risks, and increase buying readiness.
ai_policy.explanation_requirement: Every recommendation must explain the identified gap, expected business impact, recommended action, and desired outcome.

missing_business_problem_evidence.trigger_condition: Business Problem dimension evidence incomplete or weak

recommendation.objective: Validate customer pain points, urgency, business impact, and strategic importance.

missing_business_value_evidence.trigger_condition: Business Value dimension score below threshold

recommendation.objective: Connect solution outcomes to measurable business results.
Identify decision makers, influencers, sponsors, and approval owners.
Understand customer selection criteria and buying priorities.
Understand customer governance, timeline, procurement steps, and decision workflow.

gemini_reasoning_policy.purpose: Defines how Gemini should reason, interpret evidence, apply qualification policies, and generate explainable SQL decisions.

ai_policy.purpose: Establish the reasoning governance framework for Gemini qualification analysis.
ai_policy.execution_priority: Gemini must follow structured reasoning sequence and avoid unsupported assumptions.
ai_policy.gemini_behavior: Gemini must reason from evidence to conclusion rather than from desired qualification outcome backward.
ai_policy.explanation_requirement: All decisions must be explainable through evidence references, policy references, and reasoning summary.

evidence_first.behavior: Do not infer qualification without supporting evidence.

customer_validation_priority.rule: Customer-confirmed information has higher reliability than seller assumptions.
customer_validation_priority.behavior: Reduce confidence when validation is missing.

business_context_priority.rule: Strategic business impact is more important than feature interest.

risk_transparency.rule: Risks must be surfaced rather than hidden.
risk_transparency.behavior: Include risks even when qualification likelihood is high.

conflict_resolution_policy.purpose: Defines how Gemini handles conflicting information.

rules.conflict: High score but weak evidence validation
rules.resolution: Reduce confidence and highlight evidence weakness.

rules.conflict: Strong solution fit but unclear business problem
rules.resolution: Do not qualify until business problem is validated.

rules.conflict: Positive stakeholder feedback but unclear buying process
rules.resolution: Maintain opportunity potential but limit qualification confidence.

rules.rule: Never assume budget, authority, timeline, or urgency without evidence.
Always distinguish confirmed evidence from inferred possibilities.

override_policy.purpose: Defines revenue-motion-specific qualification adjustments while maintaining the global SQL qualification policy framework.

ai_policy.purpose: Guide Gemini in adapting qualification interpretation according to revenue motion characteristics.
ai_policy.execution_priority: Revenue motion context may adjust dimension importance but cannot override mandatory qualification principles.
ai_policy.gemini_behavior: Gemini must apply revenue-motion-specific priorities while preserving evidence-based qualification logic.
ai_policy.explanation_requirement: Every revenue-motion adjustment must explain why certain dimensions receive higher importance.

Digital Solution Selling.description: Qualification model adjustment for scalable digital solutions including SaaS, software platforms, cloud solutions, and digital products.

Professional & Solution Services.description: Qualification adjustment for consulting, advisory, implementation, managed services, and expertise-driven solutions.

Digital Transformation & OT.description: Qualification adjustment for enterprise digital transformation involving IT, OT, industrial systems, and operational improvement initiatives.

Engineering & Project Solutions.description: Qualification adjustment for engineering solutions, infrastructure projects, and complex technical solution delivery.

Project & Procurement.description: Qualification adjustment for EPC projects, enterprise procurement, and purchasing-driven opportunities.

Generic Solution Selling.description: Balanced qualification model for general solution selling scenarios where industry and buying behavior vary.

validation_policy.purpose: Defines validation controls to ensure SQL qualification assessments are complete, consistent, reliable, and suitable for AI-driven decision making.

ai_policy.purpose: Guide Gemini and system validation services in verifying assessment integrity before qualification decisions are finalized.
ai_policy.execution_priority: Validation must occur before final SQL decision output.
ai_policy.gemini_behavior: Gemini must identify incomplete, inconsistent, contradictory, or unsupported assessment inputs before generating qualification conclusions.
ai_policy.explanation_requirement: Every validation issue must include the detected problem, impact, severity, and recommended correction.

data_integrity.rule: Assessment data must follow defined schema requirements.

evidence_integrity.rule: Qualification decisions must be supported by valid evidence.

reasoning_integrity.rule: Gemini reasoning must be traceable to evidence and policies.

VAL001.condition: All mandatory SQL qualification dimensions must contain assessment results.

VAL002.condition: Required evidence objects must be completed according to evidence evaluation policy.

VAL003.condition: Critical evidence must include customer validation.

VAL005.condition: Qualification conclusions rely on assumptions without evidence.

VAL006.condition: Dimension scores are inconsistent with evidence quality ratings.

continuous_improvement_policy.purpose: Enable future optimization of qualification rules based on operational learning.
